arStrings.szText: Between Heaven and Hell
Search for the Hands of Akarat in Temis
Search for the Hands of Akarat in Temis

The Lord of Hatred walks the streets of Temis, one of the oldest cities in Sanctuary. Yet he remains in the guise of Akarat. Why? I must travel into the heart of the city and search for his servants, the Hands of Akarat, to find out what his plans are.

Eavesdrop on Queen Adreona's conversation

Queen Adreona is preparing a ceremony to welcome Akarat to the city. She is wary of the "prophet," but she won't deny him—or his throng of followers—an audience. If I am to uncover what Mephisto is planning, I must continue my search for his servants.
